Tangential and transverse eigen-directions persist at each cycle point; multiplying exact derivatives yields mu_parallel=1-16d^2-848d^4/15+O(d^6) and mu_perp=1+224d^4/5+O(d^6)=1+(63/10)(h-4/3)^2+O((h-4/3)^3).
